evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce JoyFrontBench, a benchmark that makes this distinction through goal-oriented acceptance contracts.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Front-end coding agents are expected to produce applications that fulfill user goals, yet high task scores can coexist with failures in essential workflows.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The evaluation framework combines evidence-grounded judgments with deterministic record auditing and fixed scoring rules, preserving graded task assessment alongside explicit core-task and application-level acceptance.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate five coding models under two agent harnesses, OpenHands and OpenCode, on the 70-problem test set; the remaining 30 problems form a public set for validation and diagnostic analyses.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Derived from practitioner requirements, JoyFrontBench comprises 100 front-end development problems, 764 tasks, and 2,596 atomic criteria, with reviewed annotations linking user goals to core tasks and evidence requirements.
